definition: Relating to electricity produced by chemical action.
author: George Eliot
quote: It happened when he was studying in Paris, and just at the time when, over and above his other work, he was occupied with some galvanic experiments.
example_sentence: Her speech had a galvanic effect on the sleepy audience.
